snippet.title: Brutal Boxing Life Sim | Rising Spirit - "The Glory"
snippet.description:
🥊 Add Rising Spirit to your Steam Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126830/Rising_Spirit/

Join the upcoming Playtest and start your journey from the underground!

Channel your inner underdog in Rising Spirit, a brutal new Boxing RPG and Life Simulator inspired by anime classics like Hajime no Ippo. Start as an unknown amateur with empty pockets, work delivery jobs to survive, fight in illegal underground pits, and train your way up to the World Championship across three distinct cities.

In the ring, you will take devastating hits... but you must always STAND UP!

🔔 Subscribe for more updates and Devlogs!
#RisingSpirit #BoxingGame #IndieGame #BoxingRPG
